title: Decision: a parent-dependent room gets no Chat, because no Chat.kind describes a call
description:
Mark decided 2026-11-23, found by reading the JMAP specs against what
bead mimid-1wgh.108 built.

THE PROBLEM, and it is specified behaviour rather than an oversight.
draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Room/create: "On success the server
creates a Chat bound to the room, with roomId set to the room ID". And
draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Chat Object Fields: "kind (String,
immutable): \"direct\", \"group\", or \"channel\"".

There is no kind for a call. So every call a user starts creates a Chat,
and a stock JMAP Chat client renders it in the conversation list: an
unnamed group chat that appears when you make a call and never receives a
message. mimid exists to serve stock clients (decision mimid-1wgh.38), so
this would have shipped as the first thing a user saw of the feature.

CHOSEN: a parent-dependent room gets no Chat.

WHY:
- It is the smaller change. One sentence in the binding draft, no new
  field, and nothing in the base chat draft, whose kind is immutable with
  three values.
- It matches the model. A call is a VTCCall (decision mimid-1wgh.118);
  the call room is the keying substrate underneath it, not a
  conversation. What a human sees of a call is the announcement in the
  PARENT chat (decisions mimid-1wgh.116, mimid-1wgh.117).
- A fourth kind value would have to be handled by every client, and a
  client that did not know it would most likely ignore the Chat, which is
  the outcome this gets without the churn.

NOT CHOSEN:
- A Chat.kind value for calls. Honest, and would let a client badge or
  hide it, but it is a base-draft change with a compatibility cost for a
  benefit this gets for free.
- Leaving it. Maximally conservative and the feature looks broken in
  exactly the clients it is for.

THE WRINKLE TO GET RIGHT, found while recording this: §Room/create's
response declares "chatId (Id): The id of the new Chat". With no Chat
there is no id, so for a parent-dependent room chatId must be absent or
null, and the draft must say which. mimid-server's room_create.rs returns
it unconditionally today (it reads the Chat back out of
projection_chats), so this is a response-shape change and not only a
suppressed write.

WHAT IT TOUCHES:
- draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Room/create: no Chat for a
  parent-dependent room, and what chatId is then. NEEDS MARK'S PER-WRITE
  OK (AGENTS.md).
- mimid-server jmap/methods/room_create.rs: skip the Chat binding, and
  answer without a chatId.
- The agent's own JMAP front end, by the same reasoning: it projects the
  agent's rooms as Chats, and a call room should not become one there
  either. Room::parent already marks it (bead mimid-1wgh.108).
close_reason: Mark 2026-11-23: no Chat for a parent-dependent room; the call is a VTCCall and the announcement lives in the parent chat.
